from logparse.parse import parse_lines
from logparse.stats import summarize


def test_summary_of_sample():
    with open("sample/access.log", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        summary = summarize(parse_lines(handle.read().splitlines()))
    assert summary["requests"] == 6
    assert summary["statuses"] == {200: 3, 304: 1, 401: 1, 404: 1}
    assert summary["top_paths"][0] == ("/index.html", 2)
    assert summary["error_rate"] == 0.333

"""Parse access log lines in the Common Log Format."""

import re
from datetime import datetime

LINE = re.compile(
    r'(?P<host>\S+) \S+ (?P<user>\S+) \[(?P<time>[^\]]+)\] '
    r'"(?P<method>[A-Z]+) (?P<path>\S+) [^"]*" (?P<status>\d{3}) (?P<size>\d+|-)'
    r'(?: "(?P<referrer>[^"]*)" "(?P<agent>[^"]*)")?'
)


def parse_line(line: str) -> dict | None:
    """Fields of one log line as a dict, or None if the line does not parse."""
    match = LINE.match(line)
    if match is None:
        return None
    entry = match.groupdict()
    entry["status"] = int(entry["status"])
    entry["size"] = 0 if entry["size"] == "-" else int(entry["size"])
    entry["when"] = datetime.strptime(entry["time"], "%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S %z")
    return entry


def parse_lines(lines: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
    """Parse many lines; lines that do not parse are dropped."""
    return [entry for entry in map(parse_line, lines) if entry is not None]


BOT_MARKERS = ("bot", "crawler", "spider", "slurp")


def is_bot(entry: dict) -> bool:
    """True when the user agent looks like a crawler."""
    agent = (entry.get("agent") or "").lower()
    return any(marker in agent for marker in BOT_MARKERS)

from logparse.parse import parse_line, parse_lines

LINE = '192.0.2.10 - - [10/Oct/2023:13:55:36 -0700] "GET /index.html HTTP/1.1" 200 2326'


def test_parse_line_fields():
    entry = parse_line(LINE)
    assert entry["host"] == "192.0.2.10"
    assert entry["path"] == "/index.html"
    assert entry["status"] == 200 and entry["size"] == 2326


def test_dash_size_is_zero():
    assert parse_line(LINE.replace(" 2326", " -"))["size"] == 0


def test_bad_lines_are_skipped():
    assert parse_lines([LINE, "garbage", ""]) == [parse_line(LINE)]
